title: Consciousness -- The Mirror

canonical_node.axiom: Consciousness is self-referential, oriented relation; it is not an added substance but the framework looking at itself.
definitions: L3 Consciousness: self-referential relation (requires A4 orientation).
L4 Faith: relation oriented toward ground (source recognition).
Consciousness Ladder equation: dC/dt = O*G(1-C) - S*C.
O = voluntary coupling, G = grace input, S = entropy, C = coherence.
derivation: A1-A3 give relation but not self-reference.
A4 (orientation) is required for the L3 fold; without it, self-reference is a loop, not consciousness.
Therefore, consciousness requires representation, self-reference, and orientation.
Morality is constitutive because A4 is the moral gradient.
The triadic structure (knower/known/knowing) is the minimal self-grounding terminus for internal regress.
The hard problem is reframed, not dissolved.
canonical_node.action: Model consciousness as self-referential, oriented relation; keep two open holes visible; separate proof classes; use Lean only for conditional dependency structure.
boundary: Does not prove humans are conscious.
Does not prove AI is or is not conscious.
Does not derive qualia from a non-relational substrate.
Does not claim the hard problem is solved.
Does not present theology as physics.
test: Kill condition: demonstrate L3 consciousness without orientation architecture.
Kill condition: derive qualia from non-relational substrate.
Lean targets: dependency skeleton, regress exit typology, triad coupling gate, agency wiring, ladder consequences, quarantine guards.

dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides a structural model of consciousness as self-referential oriented relation without adding new physics.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the four axioms and the relational substrate; does not introduce new operators.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: If self-reference or orientation is removed, the L3 fold collapses into mere recursion or a loop.
dg5_translation_registers: Theology: image of God, Trinity, fall/restoration.
Philosophy: hard problem, internal regress, eliminativism.
Bridge: structural model, proof classes separated.

classification.recommended_atom_action: Quarantine as structural model; keep open holes visible; do not present as proof.

overstatement_risks: Claiming consciousness is solved or derived.
Using Godel/Tarski/Turing as proof of triadic consciousness.
Declaring AI conscious or not conscious.
Treating scalar-field equilibrium as deriving consciousness.
kill_conditions: Demonstrate L3 consciousness without orientation architecture.
Show consciousness orientation is continuous rather than bimodal (if binary model claimed).
risk.lean_target: Formalize conditional dependency structure: consciousness requires representation, self-reference, orientation; source recognition requires consciousness.

plain_summary: This document proposes that consciousness is not an added property but the relational framework turning inward, requiring self-reference and orientation. It maps consciousness to a ladder from physics to faith, claims morality is constitutive, and argues for a triadic structure mirroring the Trinity. It explicitly acknowledges open objections and kill conditions, and restricts Lean formalization to conditional dependencies, not existence proofs.
